map.按相机分辨率、文件格式（JPEG/RAW）与拍摄张数估算存储需求：不同格式与压缩: Estimate storage needs from camera resolution, file format (JPEG/RAW) and shot count: different formats and compression rates map to different bytes per pixel, for memory-card capacity planning and spare cards.

map.谷歌新格式，兼具体积和质量，网页常用: Google's new format, balances size and quality, common on the web
